faqs.question: Do I need to be home during the cleaning appointment?
faqs.answer: No, you do not need to be home. Over 75% of our Dallas clients provide entry via smart keypad, lockbox, or apartment concierge. Our bonded staff locks up securely after completing the 40-point checklist.

faqs.question: How does your 24-Hour Sparkle Guarantee work?
faqs.answer: If any detail does not meet five-star hotel standards, simply message us within 24 hours with a photo. A crew member returns and recleans the missed area at zero cost to you.

faqs.question: Do your crews bring their own equipment and supplies?
faqs.answer: Yes, our crew arrives fully equipped with commercial HEPA vacuums, fresh color-coded microfiber sets, step ladders, and hospital-grade eco-friendly sanitizing solutions.

faqs.question: How are your cleaning professionals vetted and insured?
faqs.answer: Every cleaner passes strict 7-year nationwide criminal background clearances and identity verification. All work is covered by our $2,000,000 commercial liability policy with Hiscox.
